title: cotyledon orbiculata var. flanaganii
intro: Cotyledon orbiculata var. flanaganii, commonly known as Flanagan's Pride, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Asclepiadaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties and is traditionally believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Cotyledon orbiculata var. flanaganii include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various skin conditions. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
